[VSCode] Added "Run in background" to a running command or sub-agent, to move it to the background and keep working
[VSCode] Added the output of background shells and Monitors to their cards in the agent map
[VSCode] Fixed settings dialogs blaming a timeout when Claude Code's reply was too large to confirm a save
[VSCode] Fixed reopening a cloud session that the side bar already brought to this machine opening it again in a new tab; the side bar is shown instead
[VSCode] Fixed the side bar's Web tab not listing cloud sessions started after the window loaded; a failed load now says "Remote server is not connected" instead of "No web sessions yet"
[VSCode] Fixed a tab restored after a reload starting a second Claude process on a conversation the side bar already has open; it now shows the "still open somewhere else" notice
[VSCode] Fixed tool-row file links, session-list links and two hints showing in plain text
[VSCode] Fixed a background agent's still-running command showing as failed once the main turn ended
[VSCode] Fixed a user's own `/usage` or `/context` command opening the extension's dialog instead of running when picked from the command menu
[VSCode] Fixed file links in the plan preview tab doing nothing when clicked; they now open the file like links in chat replies
[VSCode] Fixed opening a tool's input or output in an editor tab failing with "Timeout waiting after 1000ms" on remote hosts such as WSL when the tab is slow to appear
[VSCode] Improved the Manage plugins dialog: a failed marketplace add, remove or refresh now says what went wrong
[VSCode] Changed the Claude in Chrome "Enabled by default" switch to also connect the editor's own sessions, which still ask before browser actions
[Cloud sessions] Fixed occasional failures to fetch from or push to GitHub when GitHub briefly refused a newly issued access token
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude posting a failure warning, such as a spend limit notice, in a Slack thread when a background event like GitHub activity woke it and nobody was waiting on a reply
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings leaving out recently created and private channels in organizations with many channels
[Claude Tag] Improved Claude's task list in long Slack threads: background work no longer reposts it as a new message on its own, so people following the thread aren't notified
[Code Review] Fixed finding comments and their "Why this was flagged" text stopping mid-sentence; they now end on a complete sentence
[Code Review] Fixed Code Review skipping a pull request after a new push when its review had failed twice on the previous commit; it now reviews the latest commit
[Code Review] Improved the failed-review card on a pull request whose conversation is locked: it now says the lock blocked the review and that nothing was posted or charged

title.zh-TW: Claude Mods 深度模組架構上線，新增貼身提醒副手
title.en: Claude Mods deep module architecture launches, with a built-in close-watch reminder assistant

body.zh-TW: 當你專注趕工而擔心漏看關鍵細節時，全新的模組擴充功能能派上用場。Claude Mods 讓外掛能修改更深層的系統運作方式。官方隨附名為 You should know 的內建模組，執行時會有獨立的副手代理人在旁協助把關，主動標記雙方可能遺漏的細節。在開啟遙測的官方工作階段中，於 Claude 的互動介面輸入 `/plugin enable cc-plugin-you-should-know@builtin`，就能啟用。⟦好比在廚房炒菜時身旁站著資深二廚，不搶著揮鍋，卻能在調味過量或火候過大時及時拍肩提醒。⟧
body.en: When you're heads-down rushing work and worried about missing key details, the new module extension capability comes in handy. Claude Mods lets plugins modify deeper layers of how the system works. It ships with a built-in module called You should know, which runs a dedicated assistant agent alongside you to help keep watch, proactively flagging details either side might have missed. In official sessions with telemetry enabled, type `/plugin enable cc-plugin-you-should-know@builtin` in Claude's interactive interface to enable it. ⟦It's like having a seasoned sous-chef standing beside you while you stir-fry—never grabbing the wok, but tapping your shoulder in time when the seasoning runs heavy or the heat runs too high.⟧

items.original:
Added Claude Mods: plugins may now modify deeper behavior
Added You should know, a built-in mod where a side agent watches your back and flags things you or Claude might miss. Turn it on with `/plugin enable cc-plugin-you-should-know@builtin` (for first-party sessions with telemetry on)

title.zh-TW: 代理人清單支援名稱篩選，折疊區塊也能直接開啟
title.en: Agent list supports name filtering, and collapsed sections can be opened directly

body.zh-TW: 當你背景開了數十個工作階段而找不到特定任務時，代理人清單現在能快速搜尋。在 agents 檢視畫面中輸入 `n:<關鍵字>`，就能同時比對工作階段名稱與任務內容。即使符合條件的項目藏在折疊區塊內，篩選器也會完整列出，按下 Enter 鍵還能直接開啟第一筆搜尋結果。⟦宛如在圖書館密密麻麻的書架間使用快速索引機，輸入書名代碼就自動展開收攏的書櫃並指出第一本書的位置。⟧
body.en: When you have dozens of sessions running in the background and can't find a specific task, the agent list now supports quick search. In the agents view, type `n:<keyword>` to match both session names and task content at once. Even if matching items are hidden inside collapsed sections, the filter lists them all, and pressing Enter opens the first search result directly. ⟦Picture using a quick index machine among a library's densely packed shelves: enter a title code and it automatically unfolds the collapsed bookcase and points out where the first book sits.⟧

items.original: Added an `n:<text>` filter to the agents view that matches session names and tasks; a filter now shows matches in collapsed sections and Enter opens the first match

title.zh-TW: 遙測事件新增提示詞欄位，相容巢狀鍵監控後台
title.en: Telemetry events gain a prompt field, compatible with nested-key monitoring backends

body.zh-TW: 管理雲端監控與追蹤紀錄時，特定後台可能無法順利解析帶有句點的欄位名稱。在 OpenTelemetry（一套收集日誌與效能數據的開放標準）的 `user_prompt` 事件中，新增了名為 `prompt_text` 的欄位，內容是 `prompt` 的完整副本。當你的日誌後端會把點號鍵名拆成一層層巢狀結構時，讀取這個新欄位就不會出錯。只要你在遮蔽或過濾敏感提示詞，記得將這個新欄位一併處理。⟦正如在同一件行李上掛上不同語言的名牌，讓習慣各類掃描設備的轉運站都能順利辨識。⟧
body.en: When managing cloud monitoring and trace records, certain backends may fail to parse field names containing dots. In the OpenTelemetry (an open standard for collecting logs and performance data) `user_prompt` event, a new field named `prompt_text` has been added, containing a full copy of `prompt`. When your log backend splits dotted key names into layers of nested structure, reading this new field won't error out. If you mask or filter sensitive prompts, remember to handle this new field as well. ⟦Think of attaching name tags in different languages to the same piece of luggage, so transfer stations used to all kinds of scanning equipment can identify it smoothly.⟧

items.original: Added `prompt_text` to the OpenTelemetry `user_prompt` event, a copy of `prompt` for backends that nest dotted keys; drop or mask it wherever you drop or mask `prompt` (anthropics/claude-code#70763)

title.zh-TW: 擴充工具支援網址互動引導，登入授權更順暢
title.en: Extension tools support URL interactive elicitation, making login authorization smoother

body.zh-TW: 當外接工具需要引導你前往特定網頁完成登入時，現在能直接跳出網址提示。此版本支援了 2025-11-25 協定版本的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）網址引導功能。⟦就像在服務台辦理手續時，專員直接遞上一張印有專屬網址的引導卡片，點開就能完成登入授權，不必再像過去那樣自己四處尋找開通頁面。⟧更新後若有特定伺服器無法連線，只要在該 MCP 伺服器的設定區塊加入 `{"bareElicitationCapability": true}` 即可恢復相容。
body.en: When an external tool needs to guide you to a specific web page to complete login, it can now pop up a URL prompt directly. This version supports the URL elicitation feature from the 2025-11-25 protocol version of MCP (Model Context Protocol, the protocol that lets AI connect to external tools). ⟦Like a clerk at the service counter handing you a guidance card printed with a dedicated URL—open it to complete login authorization, instead of hunting around for the activation page yourself as before.⟧ After updating, if a particular server can't connect, just add `{"bareElicitationCapability": true}` to that MCP server's configuration block to restore compatibility.

items.original: Added URL prompts from MCP servers on the 2025-11-25 protocol, for example to sign in. If a server no longer connects after this update, add "bareElicitationCapability": true to its MCP config entry

title.zh-TW: Windows 命令工具加速，管線重導向與工具停用提示更清楚
title.en: Windows command tool speedup, with clearer pipeline redirection and tool-disable notices

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境下執行指令或串接管線時，現在執行更順暢且錯誤提示更清晰。當拒絕授權 Bash 工具而連帶關閉 PowerShell 時，啟動時會主動發出警告，避免出現完全沒有可用終端機工具的窘境。互動模式在遇到管線輸入或重導向時不再意外卡死或崩潰，會清楚說明原因後結束；若使用管線輸入，可改用 `-p` 模式。系統還移除了指令執行前多餘的子行程（由主程式分支出來執行的獨立作業），提升命令執行速度。⟦跟車輛儀表板在兩組動力開關同時關閉時立刻亮燈提醒一樣，出發前先確認配備齊全，油門踩起來也更輕快。⟧
body.en: Running commands or chaining pipelines on Windows is now smoother, with clearer error messages. When denying authorization for the Bash tool also shuts down PowerShell, a warning is now issued at startup, avoiding the predicament of having no usable terminal tool at all. Interactive mode no longer unexpectedly hangs or crashes when it encounters piped input or redirection—it clearly explains why and then exits; if you use piped input, switch to `-p` mode instead. The system also removed the redundant subprocess (an independent process branched off from the main program) before command execution, improving command speed. ⟦Just as a car dashboard lights up immediately when both power switches are off, you confirm your equipment is complete before setting out—and the throttle feels lighter too.⟧

items.original:
Windows: Added a startup warning when denying the Bash tool also turns off the PowerShell tool, so Claude has no shell tool
Windows: Fixed interactive `claude` hanging or crashing with "Raw mode is not supported" when its input is piped or redirected; it now says why and exits (use `-p` for piped input)
Windows: Improved Bash tool speed by removing a subshell that ran before every command

title.zh-TW: 自託管環境內建 GitHub 介面指令，未裝命令列工具也能通
title.en: Self-hosted environments get a built-in GitHub interface command, working even without the CLI installed

body.zh-TW: 當你在團隊自建的執行主機上跑自動化流程，需要向 GitHub 存取資料時，省去了手動補齊工具的麻煩。於 macOS 與 Linux 環境中，使用官方託管 Git 的工作階段已內建 `gh api` 功能。即使主機未事先安裝相關指令套件，系統也能直接透過 REST 介面存取各項遠端資源。⟦彷彿出差時隨身手提箱內建了通用網路轉接頭，就算到了沒有專屬設備的會議室也能立刻連線。⟧
body.en: When you run automation on your team's self-hosted runners and need to access data from GitHub, you're spared the hassle of manually installing tools. On macOS and Linux, sessions using officially hosted Git now have `gh api` built in. Even if the host doesn't have the related command package preinstalled, the system can access remote resources directly through the REST interface. ⟦It's like a carry-on suitcase with a universal network adapter built in for business trips—even in a meeting room without dedicated equipment, you can connect right away.⟧

items.original: Self-hosted runner: Added a built-in `gh api` (REST only) for sessions that use Anthropic-managed git on macOS and Linux machines where the GitHub CLI is not installed

title.zh-TW: 遠端操控連線更穩定，修復休眠中斷與重試停滯
title.en: Remote control connections are more stable, fixing sleep interruptions and retry stalls

body.zh-TW: 當你透過遠端操控或在代理人環境執行任務時，連線現在更加穩定可靠。在組織允許但無專屬使用者帳號的遠端工作階段中，快速模式現在能正常保持開啟。遠端操控連線遇上無回應狀況時，會在三十秒後自動放棄並重新嘗試，不再枯等數分鐘。透過 HTTP 代理伺服器執行 `claude remote-control` 現在可完成註冊；先前註冊失敗時，卻會顯示誤導性的組織權限錯誤。在 Mac 閒置休眠時，執行中的工作也不會中斷。⟦正如長途通訊線路遇上雜音時會在半分鐘內主動重撥，遇到總機轉接或短暫待機也不會輕易斷線。⟧
body.en: When you run tasks via remote control or in agent environments, connections are now more stable and reliable. In remote sessions where the organization allows it but there's no dedicated user account, fast mode now stays on properly. When a remote control connection hits an unresponsive state, it now automatically gives up and retries after thirty seconds, instead of waiting idly for minutes. Running `claude remote-control` through an HTTP proxy server can now complete registration; previously, when registration failed, it showed a misleading organization permission error. Running tasks also won't be interrupted when a Mac goes idle and sleeps. ⟦Like a long-distance line that proactively redials within half a minute when it hits static, it won't easily drop when facing a switchboard transfer or a brief standby.⟧

items.original:
Fixed fast mode staying off in remote sessions owned by an agent with no user account, even when the organization allows it
Fixed Remote Control not receiving messages for minutes at a time when a reconnect request got no response; it now gives up after 30 seconds and retries
Fixed `claude remote-control` failing to register behind an HTTP proxy with a misleading "Check your organization permissions" error (anthropics/claude-code#97352)
macOS: Fixed Remote Control sessions started with `claude remote-control` stopping mid-turn when the Mac went to idle sleep

title.zh-TW: 事件掛鉤計數精確，修復反覆喚醒與雲端同步
title.en: Event hook counts are precise, fixing repeated wake-ups and cloud sync

body.zh-TW: 當你在專案中設定自動檢查或在雲端同步外掛時，事件掛鉤的執行行為更加乾淨準確。設定非同步喚醒的掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）若缺少腳本檔，只會回報一次錯誤，不再反覆喚醒並發出通知。外掛同步的啟動掛鉤現在能在新雲端工作階段順利執行，執行紀錄也不再把內部回呼算進去，設了一個就如實顯示一個。⟦好比門鈴線路故障時只在面板亮起一次維修燈號，不再整天狂響，計次器也不會把內部自檢重複算成訪客。⟧
body.en: When you set up automated checks in a project or sync plugins in the cloud, event hook execution is cleaner and more accurate. A hook (a small program triggered when a specific event occurs) configured for asynchronous wake-up that lacks its script file now reports the error only once, instead of repeatedly waking up and sending notifications. The plugin sync startup hook now runs successfully in new cloud sessions, and execution records no longer count internal callbacks—set one and it faithfully shows one. ⟦Think of a doorbell circuit fault lighting up a single repair indicator on the panel instead of ringing all day, with the counter no longer tallying internal self-checks as visitors.⟧

items.original:
Fixed hooks configured with `asyncRewake` waking Claude over and over with "found issues" notifications when the hook's script file is missing; the broken hook is now reported once
Fixed SessionStart hooks from synced plugins not running in new cloud sessions
Fixed the transcript's "N hooks ran" summary and the verbose debug log's matched-hooks count including Claude Code's internal callbacks, so one configured hook no longer shows as two

title.zh-TW: SDK 工具心跳與串流修復，即時訊息不再中斷背景搜尋
title.en: SDK tool heartbeat and streaming fixes—urgent messages no longer interrupt background searches

body.zh-TW: 當你透過 SDK（供程式串接 Claude 的軟體套件）或指令模式自動化執行時，資料串流與背景運作更穩定。模型回覆串流停滯時，工具的心跳訊號依然會按時送達。在回覆途中切換模型後，`claude -p` 與 SDK 工作階段不會在後續每則訊息重複觸發備援機制。使用 `--output-format stream-json` 或 SDK，並以 `/<skill>` 執行 `context: fork` 技能時，技能各回合現在也會串流輸出。插隊發送的緊急訊息不會中斷背景正在進行的網頁查詢。⟦正如急件快遞送達收發室時，值班人員會立刻接件，但不會直接拔掉正在接收資料的傳真機線路。⟧
body.en: When you automate execution through the SDK (the software package for programmatically connecting to Claude) or command mode, data streaming and background operations are more stable. When the model's reply stream stalls, tool heartbeat signals still arrive on schedule. After switching models mid-reply, `claude -p` and SDK sessions no longer repeatedly trigger the fallback mechanism on every subsequent message. When using `--output-format stream-json` or the SDK and running a `context: fork` skill via `/<skill>`, each turn of the skill now streams output too. Urgent messages sent out of queue won't interrupt a web query running in the background. ⟦Picture an urgent courier delivery arriving at the mailroom: the staff on duty takes it immediately, but doesn't unplug the fax machine that's mid-reception.⟧

items.original:
Fixed tool heartbeats not reaching SDK hosts while the model's response stream was stalled with no data arriving
Fixed `claude -p` and SDK sessions repeating a model fallback on every later message after the model was switched while a reply was running
Fixed `--output-format stream-json` and the SDK not streaming the turns of a `context: fork` skill run by typing `/<skill>` as the prompt, as they do for the Skill tool's fork
Improved SDK sessions so a message sent with priority "now" no longer cancels a running web fetch or web search; it keeps loading in the background

title.zh-TW: 企業雲端模型檢查修復，護欄阻擋與標頭驗證更精確
title.en: Enterprise cloud model check fixes, with more precise guardrail blocks and header validation

body.zh-TW: 企業透過雲端通道租用模型時，啟動檢查與安全防護回應更清晰穩定。啟動時的模型清單檢查不再遺漏受控設定，選單能完整呈現所有可用型號。思考回覆過程中若觸發安全護欄阻擋，現在會清楚顯示護欄的說明文字而非泛用系統錯誤。關閉實驗功能時，工作階段標題與提示掛鉤請求會徹底移除雲端網關拒收的格式。在 `CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_*_AUTH` 檢查中，若 `ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS` 重複指定 `Authorization`，模型可用性檢查送出的授權標頭現在會與實際請求一致。Claude apps 閘道在 Amazon Bedrock 拒收模型 ID 時，開發者會在畫面上看到哪個模型不可用，閘道紀錄也會寫出實際送出的 ID。⟦如同商務大樓門禁系統在訪客換證時精準核對通行名單，遇到管制區域也會清楚告知原因，而非亮出籠統的故障燈。⟧
body.en: When enterprises rent models through cloud channels, startup checks and safety guardrail responses are clearer and more stable. The model list check at startup no longer misses managed settings, so the menu fully shows all available models. If a safety guardrail block is triggered during a thinking reply, the guardrail's explanatory text now displays clearly instead of a generic system error. When experimental features are turned off, session title and prompt hook requests thoroughly remove the format the cloud gateway rejects. In `CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_*_AUTH` checks, if `ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS` specifies `Authorization` more than once, the authorization header sent by the model availability check now matches the actual request. When Amazon Bedrock rejects a model ID, the Claude apps gateway shows developers on screen which model is unavailable, and the gateway log records the ID actually sent. ⟦Like an office building's access system precisely checking the approved list when a visitor swaps badges, it clearly states the reason when a restricted area is hit, rather than flashing a vague fault light.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Bedrock and Vertex startup model checks ignoring an enforced `availableModels` list, which could collapse `/model` to one Opus row
Fixed Amazon Bedrock Guardrails blocks that arrive mid-response ending the turn with an API error instead of the guardrail's message when the reply began with thinking
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` not removing the structured-output format from session-title and prompt-hook requests, which Bedrock-backed gateways reject
Bedrock, Vertex, Mantle: Fixed model availability checks under `CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_*_AUTH` sending a different `Authorization` header than real requests when `ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS` repeats it
Improved the Claude apps gateway's error when Amazon Bedrock rejects a model ID: developers now see which model is unavailable, and the gateway log names the ID that was sent

title.zh-TW: 模型切換保留思考深度，雲端預設開啟百萬上下文
title.en: Model switching preserves thinking depth; 1M context on by default in the cloud

body.zh-TW: 在不同模型間切換或需要顧問協助時，各項設定與紀錄能妥善保留。以 claude.ai 登入並在 `/model` 選擇 Fable 時，儲存的預設模型會跟隨最新版；在 Opus 5.5 與 Sonnet 5.5 間切換，不再改寫工具紀錄而弄丟先前的深度思考。Opus 4.7 以上與 Fable 在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 和 Claude apps gateway 預設使用 1M 上下文空間且不需 `[1m]` 後綴，設定 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1` 可維持 200K。`/advisor` 現支援 Sonnet 5.5 擔任 Opus 4.7 與 4.8 的顧問，並會事先指出 API 不接受的配對。因安全標記切換模型時，也會維持你原先指定的思考力度。⟦彷彿交接診斷筆記，換人諮詢依然維持原訂深度，無須從頭交代。⟧
body.en: When switching between models or calling in an advisor, your settings and history are properly preserved. When you sign in with claude.ai and pick Fable in `/model`, the saved default model follows the latest version; switching between Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 no longer rewrites tool history and loses your earlier deep thinking. Opus 4.7 and above, plus Fable, default to 1M context on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and the Claude apps gateway with no `[1m]` suffix needed, and setting `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1` keeps you at 200K. `/advisor` now supports Sonnet 5.5 advising Opus 4.7 and 4.8, and flags pairings the API won't accept ahead of time. When a safety flag triggers a model switch, the thinking effort you originally specified is kept too. ⟦A doctor hands over diagnostic notes to a colleague, and the new consultation keeps the originally planned depth without starting the story over.⟧

items.original:
Fixed picking Fable in `/model` on a claude.ai login saving the current version's id, so your saved default now follows the newest Fable like Opus and Sonnet do
Fixed switching between Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 (`/model`, `opusplan`) rewriting earlier MCP tool announcements, which could drop earlier extended thinking
Fixed `/advisor` pairing checks: Sonnet 5.5 can now advise Opus 4.7 and 4.8, and advisors the API would refuse are flagged up front instead of being silently dropped
Changed Opus 4.7+ and Fable to use a 1M context window by default on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and the Claude apps gateway, with no `[1m]` suffix (`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1` keeps 200K)
Changed automatic model switches after a flagged message to keep your current effort level instead of the new model's default

title.zh-TW: 終端機指令安全防護升級，敏感檔案寫入嚴格攔截
title.en: Terminal command safeguards upgraded, sensitive file writes strictly intercepted

body.zh-TW: 當你放手讓 AI 批量清理目錄或執行各類系統腳本時，潛在的危險操作現在受到更嚴謹的把關。對 `/` 或家目錄執行危險 `rm`，且同一指令把輸出重導向到 `~` 或萬用字元路徑時，不再漏掉確認提示；權限選單也改以白話說明取代內部代碼。Linux 沙盒中的 Bash 指令不再繼承 Claude Code 執行檔已開啟的控制代碼。透過已提交至儲存庫的符號連結（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）寫入敏感位置或工作目錄外時，會指出最終落點並等待人工同意。即使設定了整個 `Bash` 工具的允許規則或允許執行的 hooks，對 Claude Code 檔案工具直接拒絕寫入的檔案（Anthropic 個人資料儲存處、主機憑證檔），shell 寫入也只會跳出確認、不會直接執行。⟦宛如大樓保全升級門禁把關，即便持有通用證件，進入核心機房時仍必須親自簽名核准。⟧
body.en: When you let the AI loose on batch-cleaning directories or running all kinds of system scripts, potentially dangerous operations are now gated more rigorously. Running a dangerous `rm` against `/` or your home directory while the same command redirects output to `~` or a wildcard path no longer slips past the confirmation prompt; the permission menu also now explains things in plain language instead of internal codes. Bash commands inside the Linux sandbox no longer inherit handles already opened by the Claude Code executable. Writing to sensitive locations or outside the working directory through a symlink (a shortcut file pointing to another location) committed to the repository now shows the final destination and waits for human approval. Even with an allow rule covering the entire `Bash` tool or hooks permitted to run, files that Claude Code's file tools flat-out refuse to write (Anthropic's personal data store, host credential files) will only trigger a confirmation for shell writes, never silent execution. ⟦A building upgrades its security desk: even with an all-access badge, entering the core server room still requires signing in person.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a dangerous `rm` (such as one on `/` or the home directory) losing its always-ask safeguard when the same command also redirected output to a `~` or wildcard path
Fixed Bash permission prompts showing internal parser names such as "Contains simple_expansion" instead of a plain explanation
Fixed sandboxed Bash commands on Linux inheriting an open handle on the Claude Code executable
Changed a shell write through a repo-committed symlink onto a sensitive file or out of the working tree to name where it lands and wait for a person, on lines with a `~` target too
Changed whole-tool `Bash` allow rules and allowing hooks to prompt for, not run, shell writes to files Claude Code's file tools refuse outright (the Anthropic profile store, the host credentials file)

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮不再重複載入設定，動態加入專案即時生效
title.en: Conversation compaction no longer double-loads settings; mid-session project additions take effect immediately

body.zh-TW: 當對話內容過長觸發自動精簡或恢復先前進度時，各項專案設定能準確維持。恢復工作階段或執行對話壓縮（自動精簡長對話以節省空間的機制）後，資料夾的 `CLAUDE.md` 不會被重複載入兩次，壓縮後提交署名提醒也不再出現在工具結果裡。雲端階段在對話壓縮途中重啟不會弄丟前半段對話，雲端與 SDK 工作階段中途新增的儲存庫，現在會載入其技能與外掛，`CLAUDE.md` 也不會在切換目錄後才延遲載入。⟦跟整理長篇會議紀錄一樣，精簡摘要時不會把開場規章重複影印兩次，中途遞交的新議程也能立刻附進資料夾。⟧
body.en: When an over-long conversation triggers automatic compaction or you resume earlier progress, project settings stay accurate. After resuming a session or running conversation compaction (the mechanism that automatically condenses long conversations to save space), a folder's `CLAUDE.md` is no longer loaded twice, and the post-compaction commit-attribution reminder no longer shows up in tool results. A cloud session restarting mid-compaction no longer loses the first half of the conversation, and repositories added mid-session in cloud and SDK sessions now have their skills and plugins loaded, with `CLAUDE.md` no longer loading late only after you switch directories. ⟦Condensing the minutes of a long meeting doesn't photocopy the opening rules twice, and a new agenda item handed in midway gets slipped into the folder right away.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a folder's CLAUDE.md being attached a second time after resuming a session or after a compaction
Fixed the commit attribution reminder being delivered inside a tool result after a compaction
Fixed cloud sessions sometimes losing the earlier conversation when the session restarted while it was being compacted
Fixed repositories added mid-session in cloud and SDK sessions not loading their skills and plugins, and loading CLAUDE.md late, after Claude changed directory

title.zh-TW: 背景代理人管理更順暢，支援指令排隊與授權提示
title.en: Smoother background agent management, with command queuing and permission prompts

body.zh-TW: 當你派發多個背景代理人平行處理任務時，清單檢視與指令互動更加順手。背景任務結束並清理工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）後，工作階段依然能從管理清單中順利重新開啟。背景中正在等待審核的提示會清楚列在清單中。代理人回覆改為循序排隊送達，回合進行中輸入的斜線指令（除了 `/stop` 會立刻中斷）都會在當前回合完成後依序執行。⟦正如主管查閱外勤同仁進度，臨時工位拆除後仍能調閱紀錄，等候簽核的文件清楚標記，新交辦的事項也會排入佇列等手邊告一段落立刻處理。⟧
body.en: When you dispatch multiple background agents to handle tasks in parallel, list viewing and command interaction feel much smoother. After a background task finishes and its worktree (Git's feature for running multiple parallel copies of the same project) is cleaned up, the session can still be reopened from the management list without trouble. Prompts awaiting approval in the background are now clearly listed. Agent replies are now delivered in a sequential queue, and slash commands typed while a turn is in progress (except `/stop`, which interrupts immediately) run in order once the current turn completes. ⟦A manager reviews field staff progress: records stay retrievable after a temporary desk is torn down, documents awaiting sign-off are clearly marked, and newly assigned items join the queue to be handled the moment the current work wraps up.⟧

items.original:
Fixed background sessions that could not be reopened from `claude agents` after the agent exited and removed the worktree the session was started in
Fixed `claude agents` sometimes not showing the permission prompt a background session is waiting on
Changed replies from `claude agents` to arrive as queued messages; slash commands other than `/stop` sent while a turn is running now run when it ends

title.zh-TW: 終端機滾動不再崩潰，按鍵貼上與授權提示體驗改善
title.en: Terminal scrolling no longer crashes; key pasting and permission prompts improved

body.zh-TW: 在長對話中捲動畫面或審核授權時，終端機的視覺回饋與操作細節更加穩定。系統負載高時長按捲動鍵不再導致全螢幕介面意外崩潰；使用 `--include-partial-messages` 時，被截短的回覆不再過晚或漏送 `message_stop`，應用程式不會再把它誤顯示為仍在進行。開啟減少動態效果時動畫會確實靜止；在 `/rewind` 確認畫面輸入備註時，「多久以前」的時間不再跳動。淺色主題增強了輸入框外框與歷史箭頭的對比度。Windows、Linux 的右鍵貼上及 Linux 的中鍵貼上改在放開按鈕時生效，放開前移開指標可取消；多個待審核提示則由舊到新依序排列，不再突兀覆蓋目前畫面，但有倒數計時的提示仍會顯示在最上層。⟦如同翻閱厚重帳本時紙張滑順不卡頁，待簽核的單據按送達順序排列，限時單據則放在最上方。⟧
body.en: When scrolling through long conversations or reviewing permissions, the terminal's visual feedback and interaction details are more stable. Holding a scroll key under heavy system load no longer crashes the full-screen interface unexpectedly; with `--include-partial-messages`, truncated replies no longer send `message_stop` too late or drop it, so apps no longer misread them as still in progress. Animations truly stop when reduced motion is enabled, and the "how long ago" time no longer jumps around while you type a note on the `/rewind` confirmation screen. The light theme boosts contrast for the input box border and history arrows. Right-click paste on Windows and Linux, and middle-click paste on Linux, now take effect on button release, so moving the pointer away before releasing cancels; multiple pending prompts are ordered oldest to newest instead of abruptly covering the current screen, though prompts with countdown timers still appear on top. ⟦Flipping through a heavy ledger, the pages glide without sticking; slips awaiting sign-off are stacked in arrival order, with time-limited ones placed on top.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a cause of fullscreen sessions on slow or busy machines exiting with "Claude Code exited after an unrecoverable interface error" while a scroll key was held in a long conversation
Fixed `--include-partial-messages` sending a cut-short reply's `message_stop` late or never, so apps could show the reply as still in progress
Fixed the running-tool dot and three spinners still moving with the "Reduce motion" setting on, and /rewind's confirm screen updating its "ago" time while you type a note
Improved the contrast of the prompt input border in light themes and of the ❯ before your earlier messages
Changed right-click paste on Windows and Linux, and middle-click paste on Linux, to happen when the button is released; moving the pointer away before releasing cancels it
Changed waiting permission prompts to show oldest first, so a new prompt no longer covers the one you're reading (prompts with a countdown still open on top)

title.zh-TW: MCP 工具權限把關更嚴密，協定切換與提示排版最佳化
title.en: Tighter MCP tool permission checks, plus protocol switching and prompt layout polish

body.zh-TW: 當你串接外部擴充工具或在背景自動化執行時，工具權限與提示排版更加一致。組織針對 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具設定的權限上限，先前會對名稱為 `__proto__` 的工具失效，現在不再被忽略。MCP 伺服器更換所支援的協定版本時，連接器的工具呼叫不再偶爾執行兩次，也不會一直失敗到重啟為止；無頭模式（沒有視覺介面的執行模式）的工作階段不會因單次拒絕而誤判需要重新認證。各類工具呼叫與保留訊息的提示畫面統一加上虛線外框，視覺排版更整齊。⟦正如外包廠商進駐時門禁權限嚴格受控，更換通行協定後無須重新登記，各窗口的簽核單據也統一格式。⟧
body.en: When you connect external extension tools or run background automation, tool permissions and prompt layout are more consistent. Organization-set permission ceilings for MCP (Model Context Protocol, the protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) tools previously failed for tools named `__proto__`; they are no longer ignored. When an MCP server changes the protocol version it supports, connector tool calls no longer occasionally run twice, nor keep failing until restart; headless mode (running without a visual interface) sessions no longer misread a single rejection as needing re-authentication. Prompt screens for tool calls and retained messages now share a unified dashed border for tidier visual layout. ⟦An outside vendor moves in and badge permissions are strictly controlled; after the access protocol changes there's no need to re-register, and every window's sign-off slips follow one format.⟧

items.original:
Fixed organization per-tool permission ceilings being silently dropped for an MCP tool named `__proto__`
Fixed an MCP connector tool call occasionally running twice, or the connector's calls failing until restart, when its server changed which MCP protocol version it supports
Fixed headless sessions reporting an MCP server as needing authentication after one refused call, even though later calls succeed
Improved the prompt for a held message from another session to show the message between dashed lines, matching other permission prompts
Improved MCP and other tool permission prompts to show the tool call between dashed lines, matching file edit prompts

title.zh-TW: MCP 大量資料處理降載，支援工具延遲載入與獨立重試
title.en: Reduced load for large MCP payloads, with deferred tool loading and independent retries

body.zh-TW: 當外接工具回傳龐大資料或連線多組伺服器時，資源消耗與載入過程更穩定。MCP 結果存成單行 JSON（以文字儲存資料的格式）時，Claude 不再被錯誤指示使用 Read 的 `offset`、`limit` 分頁讀取，因為這種方式拆不開單一長行。處理超額資料時省下記憶體與工作階段儲存空間，也不再為了計算 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）而額外上傳。無介面模式下，多伺服器啟動時若遠端伺服器首次連線暫時失敗，會個別重試，無須等待最慢的連線。伺服器設定為 `alwaysLoad: false` 時，旗下工具會延後至工具搜尋時載入。⟦好比大宗貨物入庫時減少占用倉位，個別延遲的車輛也能在旁單獨重試進場，不必擋住其他車輛。⟧
body.en: When external tools return huge payloads or you connect multiple servers, resource consumption and the loading process are steadier. When MCP results are stored as single-line JSON (a text-based data format), Claude is no longer wrongly told to page through them with Read's `offset` and `limit`, since that approach can't split one long line. Handling oversized data now saves memory and session storage, and no extra uploads happen just to count tokens (the text units AI processes and bills by). In headless mode, if a remote server's first connection temporarily fails during multi-server startup, each one retries individually without waiting on the slowest connection. When a server is configured with `alwaysLoad: false`, its tools defer loading until tool search. ⟦Bulk freight arriving at the warehouse takes up less space, and a delayed truck can retry entry on its own off to the side without blocking the others.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Claude being told to page large MCP results saved as JSON with Read's offset and limit, which cannot split one long line
Improved MCP startup in headless mode: a remote server whose first connect fails transiently is now retried without waiting for the slowest server to finish connecting
Improved handling of large MCP tool results: less memory, smaller session files, and no extra upload to count tokens for results far over the limit
Changed MCP server `alwaysLoad: false` to defer all of that server's tools behind tool search

title.zh-TW: 螢幕閱讀器搜尋與選單修復，按鍵指引更精確（上）
title.en: Screen reader search and menu fixes, more precise key guidance (part 1)

body.zh-TW: 依賴報讀軟體操作終端機時，搜尋框游標位置與選單按鍵指引現在更加準確。搜尋框與登入驗證碼欄位中的游標不再偏離輸入字元。回溯對話時未輸入額外備註也能直接按 Enter 確認，介面也不再顯示無效的 Tab 或方向鍵提示；空選單或搜尋框取得按鍵時，也不再誤顯示「Select with numbers」。當前一個畫面高度超出視窗時，後續的審核提示、設定變更清單，以及遭拒計畫那一行的頂部內容都能完整讀出。⟦正如無障礙語音導覽機精確對準目前輸入位置，只播報有效按鍵，換頁時也不再漏讀開頭段落。⟧
body.en: When operating the terminal with screen-reading software, the search box cursor position and menu key guidance are now more accurate. The cursor in search boxes and login verification-code fields no longer drifts away from the character being typed. When rewinding a conversation you can press Enter to confirm without typing an extra note, and the interface no longer shows invalid Tab or arrow-key hints; empty menus or search boxes receiving keys no longer wrongly display "Select with numbers". When the previous screen is taller than the window, the top content of subsequent review prompts, settings-change lists, and the rejected-plan line all read out in full. ⟦An accessible audio guide locks precisely onto the current input position, announces only valid keys, and no longer skips the opening paragraph when the page turns.⟧

items.original:
Fixed screen reader mode leaving the cursor away from the typed text in search boxes (such as /resume and /permissions) and sign-in code fields
Fixed screen reader mode refusing Enter with nothing typed on /rewind's summarize options, whose added context is optional
Fixed screen reader mode showing a "Tab to amend" hint on approval prompts, where Tab does nothing
Fixed screen reader mode listing arrow keys that do nothing in /permissions and /mcp, and saying "Select with numbers" in empty menus or while a search box has the keys
Fixed screen reader mode leaving out the top lines of a second approval prompt, a changed /config row or the rejected-plan line when the previous screen was taller than the terminal window

title.zh-TW: 螢幕閱讀器檔案差異完整報讀，降低動畫干擾（下）
title.en: Screen readers now read file diffs in full, with less animation interference (part 2)

body.zh-TW: 透過報讀軟體審查程式碼變更與背景進度時，報讀干擾明顯減少且內容更完整。檔案編輯審核提示與其他差異畫面，現在能完整報讀新增、刪除或修改的文字行。傳送進度與表單檢查不再隨著動畫每格重複觸發語音，代理人清單的時間更新頻率也調降以避免語音狂跳。輸出文字時移除了行首多餘停頓，讓報讀節奏更加流暢；設定 `CLAUDE_AX_PREPARK_MS=50` 可恢復原本的停頓。⟦宛如會議即時聽打員逐句念出修改內容時，不再每秒插話報時，讓聽者能專心聽完。⟧
body.en: When reviewing code changes and background progress through screen-reading software, spoken interference drops noticeably and content is more complete. File-edit review prompts and other diff screens now fully read out added, deleted, or modified lines. Send progress and form validation no longer retrigger speech with every animation frame, and the agent list's time updates are throttled to keep speech from jumping wildly. Extra pauses at line starts when printing text have been removed for smoother reading rhythm; setting `CLAUDE_AX_PREPARK_MS=50` restores the original pause. ⟦A live meeting transcriber reads out each revision sentence by sentence, no longer cutting in every second to announce the time, so listeners can stay focused to the end.⟧

items.original:
Fixed screen reader mode leaving out the changed lines in file edit approval prompts and other diffs
Fixed screen reader mode sending the `claude --teleport` progress screen, and an MCP form field while it is being checked, to the screen reader again on every spinner frame
Fixed times in `claude agents` changing every second in screen reader mode; they now change at most every 10 seconds
Changed screen reader mode to write new or changed lines without first pausing with the cursor at the start of the line; set `CLAUDE_AX_PREPARK_MS=50` to restore the pause

title.zh-TW: 深度審查上傳引導修正，不再給出錯誤設定建議
title.en: Deep-review upload guidance fixed; no more wrong settings advice

body.zh-TW: 當你使用 `/ultrareview` 指令上傳程式碼進行深度審查時，錯誤引導更加精確。若上傳因無法解析特定編碼的 `.gitattributes` 檔而中斷，系統不再給出修改其他路徑的無關建議。上傳被拒時，也不會再錯誤引導你將專案設定變數複製進個人全域設定。⟦就像檢驗員在零件規格不合時直接指出問題尺寸，不再給出修改出廠證明或查驗無關清單的錯誤引導。⟧
body.en: When you use the `/ultrareview` command to upload code for deep review, error guidance is more precise. If an upload breaks because a `.gitattributes` file in a particular encoding can't be parsed, the system no longer suggests modifying unrelated paths. When an upload is rejected, it also no longer wrongly directs you to copy project setting variables into your personal global settings. ⟦An inspector whose part fails spec points straight at the offending dimension, no longer misdirecting you to amend the factory certificate or check unrelated lists.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `/ultrareview` giving advice about `.git/info/attributes` when the upload stops on a committed `.gitattributes` it cannot read, such as one saved as UTF-16
Fixed `/ultrareview` upload refusals advising you to copy a variable named by a repository's settings file into your own user settings

title.zh-TW: 登入憑證失效提示明確化，不再顯示模糊代碼
title.en: Clearer sign-in credential failure messages, no more vague codes

body.zh-TW: 當你的 claude.ai 登入憑證被撤銷時，系統現在會直接點出登入憑證已失效。以前登入狀態被撤銷時，終端機只會顯示模糊的 `API Error: 401`，讓人摸不著頭緒。現在系統會清楚標示「OAuth 權杖已被撤銷（OAuth token revoked）」。在 `-p` 指令模式下，錯誤訊息也會以「身分驗證失敗（Failed to authenticate）」開頭。以前你會困惑是不是網路或伺服器故障，現在一眼就能看出需要重新登入。
body.en: When your claude.ai sign-in credentials are revoked, the system now states directly that your sign-in credentials are no longer valid. Previously, when your sign-in was revoked, the terminal only showed a vague `API Error: 401`, leaving you puzzled. Now the system clearly marks it as "OAuth token revoked." In `-p` command mode, error messages also begin with "Failed to authenticate." Where you once wondered whether the network or a server had failed, you can now tell at a glance that you need to sign in again.

items.original: Fixed a revoked claude.ai login showing a generic `API Error: 401` instead of "OAuth token revoked"; in `-p` mode the error now starts with "Failed to authenticate"

title.zh-TW: 內建指令操作更順手，設定選單支援左右翻頁與鍵盤切換
title.en: Built-in commands smoother to use, settings menu supports left-right paging and keyboard switching

body.zh-TW: 在終端機中調整設定或回報問題時，各項內建指令的互動與錯誤回報更加清晰。`/config` 設定清單支援左右方向鍵雙向切換循環數值，狹窄視窗會自動折行，並支援快捷鍵快速翻頁；`/memory` 也能直接用左右鍵切換自動記憶等開關。訊息中途打入 `/skill` 名稱時能被正確識別，包括 `disable-model-invocation` 類型；問題回報指令不再將近期錯誤直接填入公開範本，而是在確認畫面完整列出。Claude in Chrome 無法連上 Chrome 時，不再誤報 JSON 解析錯誤；`/desktop` 開啟桌面版逾時或輸出過多時，錯誤訊息會指出原因。⟦如同遙控器面板有了左右微調鍵與快速換頁鈕，操作更俐落；設備故障時，螢幕也會指出出了什麼問題。⟧
body.en: When adjusting settings or reporting issues in the terminal, the built-in commands interact and report errors more clearly. The `/config` settings list supports cycling values in both directions with the left and right arrow keys, wraps automatically in narrow windows, and supports shortcut keys for quick paging; `/memory` also lets you toggle switches like auto-memory directly with the arrow keys. Typing a `/skill` name mid-message is now recognized correctly, including the `disable-model-invocation` type; the issue-report command no longer fills recent errors directly into the public template, but lists them fully on a confirmation screen. When Claude in Chrome cannot connect to Chrome, it no longer falsely reports a JSON parsing error; when `/desktop` times out or produces too much output while launching the desktop app, the error message states the cause. ⟦A remote-control panel now has fine-tuning arrow keys and a quick page button, making operation crisper; when the device fails, the screen also tells you what went wrong.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the Claude in Chrome browser picker showing a JSON parse error when Chrome could not be reached
Fixed /feedback and /bug: the pre-filled GitHub issue no longer includes your recent error messages, and the confirmation screen now lists them as part of the report
Fixed `/desktop` quoting partial output when opening Claude Desktop timed out or printed too much output; the error now names the cause
Improved `/config`: settings that cycle show ‹ › and step both ways with ←/→, narrow terminals stack each value under its label, and PgUp/PgDn page the list
Improved `/memory`: the left and right arrow keys now flip its on/off settings, such as Auto-memory
Improved `/skill` names typed mid-message: Claude is now told they are skills, including `disable-model-invocation` ones

title.zh-TW: 外掛市集支援純 HTTP 來源，相依套件安裝與快取更穩固
title.en: Plugin marketplace supports plain HTTP sources, dependency installs and more reliable caching

body.zh-TW: 當你安裝或更新自訂外掛時，套件管理流程更加平順可靠。透過純 HTTP 協定託管的儲存庫，現在支援使用 `claude plugin marketplace add --sparse` 與 `git-subdir` 安裝外掛。啟動時下載外掛不再因同時重新載入而損壞工作階段的快取（把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）檔案。市集異常時會以白話說明原因與應對步驟，清單會標註未安裝的相依套件，並在更新外掛時重新嘗試未完成的安裝。⟦比照應用程式商店的套件清單，以前遇到缺件或安裝中斷不容易看出問題；現在會標出缺件，更新時重試未完成的安裝。⟧
body.en: When you install or update custom plugins, the package management flow is smoother and more reliable. Repositories hosted over plain HTTP now support installing plugins with `claude plugin marketplace add --sparse` and `git-subdir`. Plugins downloaded at startup no longer corrupt the session's cache files (which temporarily store looked-up results for direct reuse) due to a simultaneous reload. When the marketplace misbehaves, it explains the cause and next steps in plain language, the list flags uninstalled dependencies, and updating a plugin retries any unfinished installs. ⟦Following an app store's package list, missing pieces or interrupted installs used to be hard to spot; now missing pieces are flagged, and updates retry the unfinished installs.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `claude plugin marketplace add --sparse` and `git-subdir` plugin installs failing with "transport 'http' not allowed" when the repository is served over plain http
Fixed a plugin reload that overlapped the startup `--plugin-url` download corrupting the session's cached copy of the plugin archive
Improved plugin marketplace errors to say in plain words why a marketplace was ignored or refused, and what to do
Improved plugin listings to note when a plugin's dependencies were not installed, and updating a plugin now retries an install that did not finish

title.zh-TW: 遠端檔案傳輸支援磁碟串流，失敗自動重試且等待時間放寬
title.en: Remote file transfers support disk streaming, auto-retry on failure with relaxed wait time

body.zh-TW: 當 Claude 從雲端或遠端操控工作階段傳送檔案給你時，檔案傳輸變得更加穩定可靠。遠端上傳的等待時間放寬至三十五秒；上傳逾時、網路錯誤，或伺服器回傳 502、503、504 時，會重試一次。發生暫時性問題時會主動提醒過幾分鐘後可再次索取。傳送大檔案時改直接從硬碟串流讀取，不再塞滿記憶體，超過大小限制時也會明確列出伺服器的具體上限。⟦猶如郵局寄送大型包裹時改用傳送帶逐步裝車而非一次硬搬，路上遇到短暫堵車也會自動重新配送。⟧
body.en: When Claude sends you files from the cloud or a remotely controlled session, file transfers become more stable and reliable. The wait time for remote uploads has been relaxed to thirty-five seconds; upload timeouts, network errors, or server responses of 502, 503, or 504 trigger one retry. When a temporary problem occurs, it proactively reminds you that you can request the file again in a few minutes. Large files are now streamed directly from disk instead of filling up memory, and when a size limit is exceeded, the server's specific cap is clearly listed. ⟦A post office shipping a large parcel now loads it onto the truck gradually via a conveyor belt instead of hauling it all at once, and a brief traffic jam on the road triggers automatic redelivery.⟧

items.original:
Fixed files Claude sends from cloud and Remote Control sessions failing when the upload finished just after the 30-second timeout; it now waits 35 seconds
Improved delivery of files Claude sends from cloud sessions and Remote Control: an upload that fails on a timeout, a network error or a 502, 503 or 504 is now retried once
Improved what Claude says when a file cannot be sent for a reason that may be temporary: it now mentions that you can ask for the file again in a few minutes
Improved files Claude sends from a remote session: large files now stream from disk instead of being read into memory, and a file over the size limit is refused with the server's limit named

title.zh-TW: 超大圖片自動縮放傳送，多附件傳輸上限修復
title.en: Oversized images auto-resized for sending, multi-attachment transfer limit fixed

body.zh-TW: 當你在對話中夾帶大量附件或高解析度圖片時，檔案能順暢傳送不再漏件。遠端工作階段傳送單邊超過八千像素的 PNG、JPEG、WebP 圖片原本會失敗，現在會改送縮小後的副本。從應用程式一次發送十七到二十個附件時能完整傳遞所有檔案，不再只送達前十六個。伺服器若拒收超額檔案，也會清楚說明具體原因。⟦好比寄送巨幅海報時快遞會自動折疊或捲入標準收納筒，整批多件包裹也能完整清點上車。⟧
body.en: When you attach many files or high-resolution images in a conversation, everything sends smoothly with nothing dropped. In remote sessions, sending a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image over eight thousand pixels on a side used to fail; now a scaled-down copy is sent instead. Sending seventeen to twenty attachments at once from the app now delivers every file, no longer stopping at the first sixteen. If the server rejects files over the limit, it also clearly explains the specific reason. ⟦Shipping a giant poster, the courier automatically folds it or rolls it into a standard tube, and a whole batch of parcels gets fully counted onto the truck.⟧

items.original:
Fixed PNG, JPEG and WebP images over 8,000 pixels on a side failing to send from a remote session; Claude now sends a scaled-down copy
Fixed messages sent from the Claude apps with 17 to 20 attached files delivering only the first 16
Improved the explanation Claude gives when the server refuses a file it sends from a Remote Control or cloud session, such as an oversized image

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 支援指令轉入背景執行，代理人地圖即時呈現輸出
title.en: [VSCode] Commands can move to background execution, agent map shows output live

body.zh-TW: 在 VSCode 編輯器中使用 Claude 執行長時間任務時，你可以隨時將它移到背景繼續其他工作。執行中的命令或子代理人新增了轉入背景執行選項，讓你無須在原地等待。代理人地圖卡片會即時顯示背景指令與監控工具的最新輸出，主對話回合結束時背景執行中的任務也不會被誤標為失敗。⟦如同在電腦上下載大檔案時縮小到背景，進度依然在狀態小卡片上即時跳動，主畫面則能繼續編輯其他文件。⟧
body.en: When using Claude in the VSCode editor for long-running tasks, you can move them to the background at any time and continue other work. Running commands or subagents now offer an option to move to background execution, so you don't have to wait in place. Agent map cards show the latest output of background commands and monitoring tools in real time, and tasks still running in the background are no longer mislabeled as failed when the main conversation turn ends. ⟦Downloading a large file on your computer, you minimize it to the background while progress keeps ticking live on a small status card, and the main screen stays free for editing other documents.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Added "Run in background" to a running command or sub-agent, to move it to the background and keep working
[VSCode] Added the output of background shells and Monitors to their cards in the agent map
[VSCode] Fixed a background agent's still-running command showing as failed once the main turn ended

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 側邊欄雲端階段同步改善，防止多重視窗重複開啟
title.en: [VSCode] Sidebar cloud session sync improved, duplicate windows prevented

body.zh-TW: 在 VSCode 中切換本機與雲端工作階段時，視窗管理更加井然有序。重新開啟已同步的工作階段會直接定位到側邊欄，不再開出多餘分頁。側邊欄能列出視窗開啟後新增的雲端任務；載入失敗時會顯示「Remote server is not connected」，不再誤稱沒有工作階段。重新載入後也不會重複啟動處理程序，而是標示已在其他位置開啟。瀏覽器擴充套件的預設連線開關現在也會套用至編輯器工作階段；連上後，執行瀏覽器動作前仍會詢問。⟦宛如會議室登記系統帶你走進已開通的討論室，不再重複發放門禁卡，門外看板也會顯示最新使用狀態。⟧
body.en: When switching between local and cloud sessions in VSCode, window management is more orderly. Reopening an already-synced session jumps straight to the sidebar instead of opening an extra tab. The sidebar can list cloud tasks added after the window opened; when loading fails, it shows "Remote server is not connected" instead of wrongly claiming there are no sessions. After a reload, it no longer launches duplicate processes, but marks the session as already open elsewhere. The browser extension's default connection toggle now also applies to editor sessions; once connected, it still asks before performing browser actions. ⟦A meeting-room booking system walks you into the already-open discussion room, no longer issuing duplicate access cards, and the board outside the door shows the latest usage status.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed reopening a cloud session that the side bar already brought to this machine opening it again in a new tab; the side bar is shown instead
[VSCode] Fixed the side bar's Web tab not listing cloud sessions started after the window loaded; a failed load now says "Remote server is not connected" instead of "No web sessions yet"
[VSCode] Fixed a tab restored after a reload starting a second Claude process on a conversation the side bar already has open; it now shows the "still open somewhere else" notice
[VSCode] Changed the Claude in Chrome "Enabled by default" switch to also connect the editor's own sessions, which still ask before browser actions

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 檔案超連結點擊修復，設定儲存與工具輸出載入更穩定
title.en: [VSCode] File hyperlink clicks fixed, settings saving and tool output loading more stable

body.zh-TW: 在 VSCode 擴充功能中查看檔案或執行各項指令時，操作回饋更精準。工具呼叫列的檔案連結、工作階段清單連結與兩處提示，不再誤顯為純文字；計畫預覽分頁中的檔案連結，點擊後現在會開啟檔案。在遠端或子系統環境下檢視工具輸入輸出，不再因編輯器分頁稍慢才出現就報錯逾時。選單中點選 `/usage` 與 `/context` 也能正常執行。儲存設定時不會因回覆資料較大而誤判超時，外掛管理清單操作失敗時會列出原因。
body.en: When viewing files or running commands in the VSCode extension, feedback is more accurate. File links in the tool-call row, session list links, and two prompts no longer wrongly render as plain text; file links in the plan preview tab now open the file when clicked. Viewing tool input and output in remote or subsystem environments no longer times out just because the editor tab appears slightly late. Choosing `/usage` and `/context` from the menu also runs properly. Saving settings no longer falsely reports a timeout when the reply data is large, and when a plugin management list operation fails, the reason is listed.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed settings dialogs blaming a timeout when Claude Code's reply was too large to confirm a save
[VSCode] Fixed tool-row file links, session-list links and two hints showing in plain text
[VSCode] Fixed a user's own `/usage` or `/context` command opening the extension's dialog instead of running when picked from the command menu
[VSCode] Fixed file links in the plan preview tab doing nothing when clicked; they now open the file like links in chat replies
[VSCode] Fixed opening a tool's input or output in an editor tab failing with "Timeout waiting after 1000ms" on remote hosts such as WSL when the tab is slow to appear
[VSCode] Improved the Manage plugins dialog: a failed marketplace add, remove or refresh now says what went wrong

title.zh-TW: [Cloud sessions] 雲端工作階段 GitHub 抓取與推送失敗已修復
title.en: [Cloud sessions] GitHub fetch and push failures in cloud sessions fixed

body.zh-TW: 當你剛連上雲端環境準備與遠端儲存庫同步進度時，流程不再會無故中斷。過去在雲端工作階段中，GitHub 偶爾會短暫拒絕剛核發的存取 token（用來確認身分的授權令牌），導致執行抓取或推送程式碼時失敗。⟦跟剛換發門禁卡進大樓一樣，以前刷卡時閘門偶爾會短暫拒絕通行，現在不再被擋在門外。⟧修復後，在雲端工作階段執行抓取與推送不會再因 GitHub 短暫拒絕新令牌而中斷。
body.en: When you have just connected to a cloud environment and are ready to sync progress with a remote repository, the flow no longer breaks for no reason. In cloud sessions, GitHub would occasionally briefly reject a freshly issued access token (an authorization token used to confirm your identity), causing fetch or push operations on your code to fail. ⟦With a newly issued access card entering a building, the gate would occasionally refuse entry for a moment when you swiped; now you are no longer stuck outside.⟧ After the fix, running fetch and push in a cloud session is no longer interrupted by GitHub briefly rejecting a new token.

items.original: [Cloud sessions] Fixed occasional failures to fetch from or push to GitHub when GitHub briefly refused a newly issued access token

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] Slack 討論串避免多餘通知，頻道支出上限支援私密群組
title.en: [Claude Tag] Slack threads avoid unnecessary notifications, channel spending limits support private groups

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 團隊頻道中透過標籤指派 Claude 協同工作時，通知干擾明顯降低。當背景事件喚醒機器人且無人等待回覆時，不再突兀地在討論串中張貼警告。任務清單在背景更新時不會以新訊息形式重複發送，避免打擾關注討論串的成員。對頻道很多的組織，管理員後台的支出上限清單現在能列出近期建立及私密頻道。⟦好比會議記錄員在白板上安靜更新進度，不再每改一條就敲麥克風廣播，總管清冊也如實納入所有私密小組。⟧
body.en: When assigning Claude to collaborate via tags in your team's Slack channels, notification noise drops noticeably. When a background event wakes the bot and no one is waiting for a reply, it no longer abruptly posts a warning in the thread. Task lists updated in the background are not resent as new messages, avoiding disturbing members following the thread. For organizations with many channels, the spending-limit list in the admin console can now list recently created and private channels. ⟦A meeting recorder quietly updates progress on the whiteboard instead of tapping the microphone to broadcast every change, and the manager's roster faithfully includes every private group.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude posting a failure warning, such as a spend limit notice, in a Slack thread when a background event like GitHub activity woke it and nobody was waiting on a reply
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings leaving out recently created and private channels in organizations with many channels
[Claude Tag] Improved Claude's task list in long Slack threads: background work no longer reposts it as a new message on its own, so people following the thread aren't notified

title.zh-TW: [Code Review] 程式碼審查意見完整呈現，重推推送自動重啟審查
title.en: [Code Review] Code review feedback now shown in full, and pushing again automatically restarts the review

body.zh-TW: 當你發出合併請求（Pull request）等待 AI 批閱變更，或是依據回饋再次提交更新時，檢視流程的反饋更為清晰可靠。審查報告中的各項建議與標記原因不再中途斷句，每條評語皆以完整句子呈現。若前一提交的審查失敗兩次，推送新程式碼後仍會審查最新提交，不再略過。若遇到討論串鎖定，卡片會明確說明因鎖定而未執行、未發布任何內容，也不會收取任何費用。⟦如同資深審稿員在校對稿件時寫下完整評語不留半句話，作者遞交新修訂版後會立刻重啟審閱，遇到檔案上鎖也會清楚說明未扣款。⟧
body.en: When you open a pull request and wait for the AI to review your changes, or when you submit updates based on feedback, the review process now gives clearer and more reliable responses. Suggestions and the reasons behind flags in the review report no longer get cut off mid-sentence; every comment appears as a complete sentence. If the review of a previous commit failed twice, pushing new code will still trigger a review of the latest commit instead of skipping it. If a discussion thread is locked, the card clearly states that nothing ran or was published because of the lock, and that you were not charged anything. ⟦Imagine a senior proofreader who writes out every comment in full while marking up a manuscript, never leaving a sentence half-finished; the moment the author hands in a revised draft, the review starts over right away, and if the file is locked, the proofreader clearly explains that no charge was made.⟧

items.original:
[Code Review] Fixed finding comments and their "Why this was flagged" text stopping mid-sentence; they now end on a complete sentence
[Code Review] Fixed Code Review skipping a pull request after a new push when its review had failed twice on the previous commit; it now reviews the latest commit
[Code Review] Improved the failed-review card on a pull request whose conversation is locked: it now says the lock blocked the review and that nothing was posted or charged

entries: Added a count such as "2 of 5" to the permission prompt when several permission requests stack up
Added mouse support for the "N more" rows of lists in fullscreen mode: click one to jump to that end of the list, with hover and pressed states
Fixed several Claude Code processes and IDE extensions each opening a login browser when gcpAuthRefresh or awsAuthRefresh credentials expire
Fixed `claude --resume` and `--continue` sometimes losing every turn after a batch of parallel tool calls when the earlier session crashed or was killed
Fixed API 400 errors after a tool or hook returned an object, number or boolean instead of text, including in resumed sessions
Fixed cloud sessions with very large histories never waking up because the container was stopped while the transcript was still loading

Fixed the Claude apps gateway's spend meter pricing 1-hour prompt cache writes at the cheaper 5-minute rate, and counting only the first model call's input tokens on streamed turns that run a server-side tool such as web search
Fixed macOS sessions still showing "Not logged in" or "Login expired" after `/login` succeeds in another Claude Code window when a leftover `~/.claude/.credentials.json` exists
Fixed every turn failing when the Anthropic API refuses the model your default or a model alias resolves to: Claude Code now retries once on the previous model of the same tier
Fixed Remote Control sessions (including `claude remote-control`) staying connected after your organization's policy turns Remote Control off; they now disconnect with a notice
Fixed refusal and `--fallback-model` retries failing when the fallback model can't run fast; they now run at standard speed, with a one-time notice in interactive sessions
Fixed headless sessions repeating the "MCP servers require authentication" reminder after a successful re-authentication when the MCP discovery cache is enabled
Fixed `claude auth status` reporting a Console sign-in's stored API key as `claude.ai`; it now reports `api_key`, and the VS Code extension treats that session as an API key session
Fixed `/status` listing an Anthropic profile beside an API key as if both were in effect; the profile is now marked as not in use
Fixed Claude not being told when a file attached to a message sent over Remote Control did not arrive, and a file sometimes getting only 10 seconds for its last download try
Fixed a Remote Control message that arrived while Claude Code was exiting being marked delivered and then never answered; it now stays queued for the session's next run
Fixed MCP error messages showing a credential's value when "Bearer" or "Basic" came before its key name
Fixed percent-encoded Bearer tokens being only partly masked in error messages
Fixed redacted logs and transcripts showing a secret whose key name has an invisible character inside, such as a zero-width space

Fixed logs and transcripts showing part of a URL password that contains punctuation such as `)`, quotes, `]`, `&` or a second `@`, or that runs past a `/` to a bracketed host such as `[::1]` in an ssh URL
Fixed the session transcript in the zip that `/feedback` saves to disk containing invalid JSON lines after secret redaction
Fixed MCP connectors listing no tools for up to a day after their server dropped the older MCP handshake
Fixed a repeat MCP sign-in request from Claude replacing the pending sign-in link, which could stop that link from working
Fixed `/usage` not crediting an MCP server for a tool call made while that server was still connecting or had only just connected, such as right after a restart
Fixed plugins enabled on claude.ai occasionally going missing from Claude Code for a session after a transient server error
Fixed a message typed into a running subagent showing twice in its transcript after the subagent read it
Fixed subagent hand-back messages showing a raw task id instead of the agent's name when the subagent had no registered name
Fixed foreground subagents sometimes missing the task-tracking tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) in sessions that have them enabled
Fixed subagents spawned with worktree isolation loading the project CLAUDE.md and its imports a second time from the worktree copy on their first file read
Fixed Workflow tool subagents being restarted from their original prompt when a connection stalled for a few minutes mid-response
Fixed `/compact`, `/clear`, and `/rewind` typed while viewing a background agent's or teammate's transcript silently acting on the main conversation: a dialog now names the target and asks first
Fixed background jobs showing done while waiting for your approval
Fixed the commit attribution reminder being re-sent inside tool output when a model fallback lasts only one turn
Fixed a click on the space between words of a collapsed row (such as "Thought for 4s") highlighting the row without expanding it in fullscreen mode
Fixed a row with no details, such as an action row with a long name, pushing every other row's details to the right in list screens
Fixed files with very long names not reaching a cloud session when attached to it
Fixed plugin errors for a marketplace Claude Code refuses to load: they now say why and how to fix it instead of "not found"
Fixed `/plugin`'s Discover tab showing a marketplace name unquoted in its "Checking … for new plugins" line when its rows already show that name in quotes
Improved commit guidance: when your project or user skills include one named `verify`, Claude is now told to run it right before committing, except for docs-only and tests-only commits
Improved send now (ctrl+enter) in a subagent's view: it now moves the subagent's running command to the background so your message is read right away
Improved replies from background agents to your messages so they no longer open with a separate recap of what you said

Improved claude.ai artifact link reads: WebFetch now asks the same questions as the Artifact tool's read (no artifact prompt while the session's network access is on, one per artifact while it is off), and an auto-mode yes no longer counts where only you can answer
Improved fetch, skill, file read, sandbox network, Claude in Chrome, workflow script and notebook edit permission prompts to match the look of file edit prompts
Improved Bash, PowerShell and Monitor permission prompts to show the command between dashed lines, matching file edit prompts
Improved list scrollbars in fullscreen mode: in most lists the bar no longer shifts as the "N more" rows come and go, and it now has ↑/↓ arrows you can click or hold to scroll
Improved the external editor (Ctrl+G): editors that take a line number now open on the line your cursor is on in the prompt
Improved slash command suggestion responsiveness while typing when many skills or plugin commands are installed; command descriptions now match by word prefix
Improved the output style picker: it now opens on your current style instead of Default, with each style's description on the line under its name; number keys no longer pick a style
Improved `/hooks`: the closing line of a hook's detail screen now says "this hook" instead of "it"
Improved the model fallback notice and the autocompact-thrashing error to say when a fallback dropped the context window from 1M to 200K tokens
Improved responsiveness of SDK and `-p` sessions when a host re-sends an MCP server enable for a server that is already connected
Improved the protocol page a Claude apps gateway serves at `/protocol`: it now says not to reject unknown input and matches what Claude Code sends today
Changed prompts sent while nothing is running or queued to show in the normal text color right away instead of gray
Changed how failed API requests are retried: one limit now covers a whole model call, so with the default retry settings a failing call sends at most 14 requests

Changed `--bare` to connect only the MCP servers named on the command line, send the model no system reminders, and start no background tasks; under `--bare`, a shell command that reaches its timeout now stops instead of moving to the background
Changed the send-now key (ctrl+enter) to move a skill's own shell command to the background instead of ending it
Changed the WebFetch error for a rate-limited domain safety check to tell Claude not to retry it in a loop
Changed plugin installs to refuse npm sources that are git repositories or folders, and to install plugin dependencies only from registry packages
Changed list screens (`/artifacts`, `/mcp`, `/skills`, `/hooks` and others) to always line up each row's details in one column after the names
Changed the overflow rows of lists to read "↑ N more" / "↓ N more" instead of "N more above" / "N more below"
Changed `/hooks` to open on one list of your configured hooks grouped by event, so viewing a hook takes one Enter instead of three
Changed the theme picker to a scrolling list that fits your terminal instead of pushing the preview off screen; number keys no longer pick a theme
Changed `/exit`'s Remove worktree to run after Claude Code stops the servers and shells it started there, which on Windows could keep the folder from being deleted
Changed the `claude-api` skill's Managed Agents examples to create environments with limited networking
Removed the browser link from `/ultrareview` and `claude ultrareview` output
Windows: Fixed `claude --bg` and the agents view refusing a folder that `claude` already trusts when its trust record was saved with different letter case
[VSCode] Added bookmarks: save Claude's responses and keep them in view in a Bookmarks side panel
[VSCode] Added the questions Claude asks and your answers to the conversation: after you answer a question card, a Questions row shows each question with your picks
[VSCode] Added option previews to question cards in the chat panel: the highlighted choice's mockup or snippet shows beside or under the options
[VSCode] Added rows under a message that open to the terminal output, browser tab, browser instructions and selected code sent with it
[VSCode] Fixed a second copy of a conversation opening in a tab when it was already open in the side bar; the side bar now switches to it
[VSCode] Fixed settings dialogs reporting a failed save, without re-checking, when Claude Code printed more than 1 MB of output
[VSCode] Fixed an endless "Teleporting session…" spinner when the extension stops responding
[VSCode] Improved the Manage plugins dialog: it says when a turned-off plugin is still on because of other settings, and explains a plugin folder clash
[VSCode] Changed Stop and Escape to end only the current turn; background agents keep running and can be stopped one by one from the agent map
[VSCode] Changed the "✻ Claude Code" status bar item to show in every window, so you can open Claude when no file is open
[Cloud sessions] Fixed an answered question card or approved tool call getting no reply when the session had gone idle after Claude sent a message
[Cloud sessions] Fixed clearing an organization environment's setup script in admin settings leaving new cloud sessions still running the old script
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the Runner actions menu on the self-hosted environments admin page closing on its own a few seconds after it opened
[Cloud sessions] Fixed routine runs whose cloud session never started showing as Succeeded in the Runs pane, the routine's page and the sidebar; they now show as Failed
[Cloud sessions] Fixed clicking an audio or video file in a cloud session's Outputs card opening an empty file search instead of playing the file
[Cloud sessions] Changed a routine's page to read "Due" with the scheduled time, instead of a next run time in the past, when a scheduled run is late and hasn't started
[Claude Tag] Added an Add channel button to Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings, so a limit can be set on any channel, including a private one, from its channel ID or Slack link
[Claude Tag] Fixed memory recall finding nothing in organizations that cannot use the default Sonnet model
[Claude Tag] Fixed a Slack channel losing its Claude settings when an Enterprise Grid admin moves it to another workspace and the first post afterward doesn't mention Claude
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in a Slack thread occasionally starting over on a fresh machine, losing work it hadn't pushed, when your reply answered a question it had just asked
[Claude Tag] Fixed public channel names on Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings showing as raw Slack IDs in larger organizations
[Claude Tag] Improved the titles of sessions started from Slack as shown on claude.ai: they now read as the words you typed, without Slack user IDs or escape codes

title.zh-TW: 權限提示標明待審總數，指令與工具授權畫面統一
title.en: Permission prompts show total pending count and unify command and tool authorization screens

body.zh-TW: 當 Claude 連續執行多項操作而跳出一連串授權詢問時，你現在能一眼掌握還剩幾項要確認。⟦像在銀行櫃檯抽號碼牌辦理業務，螢幕清楚顯示目前叫號與等待人數，各個窗口的申請表單也採用同一套版型。⟧權限提示在多筆請求堆疊時會顯示「2 of 5」等計數，讓你知道整體審核進度。網路擷取、技能、檔案讀取、沙盒網路、Claude in Chrome、工作流程腳本與筆記本編輯的授權面板，外觀都對齊檔案編輯提示。Bash、PowerShell 與 Monitor 指令在詢問時會以虛線框起，指令範圍更清楚。
body.en: When Claude performs multiple operations in a row and triggers a series of authorization requests, you can now see at a glance how many items remain to be confirmed. ⟦Picture taking a number ticket at a bank counter, where the screen clearly shows the current number called and the total waiting count, while application forms across different windows follow the same layout.⟧ Permission prompts now display counts such as "2 of 5" when multiple requests stack up, keeping you informed of the overall review progress. Authorization panels for web fetching, skills, file reading, sandbox network, Claude in Chrome, workflow scripts, and notebook editing all align their appearance with file edit prompts. Bash, PowerShell, and Monitor commands are framed with dashed lines during prompts, making the command boundaries clearer.

items.original:
Added a count such as "2 of 5" to the permission prompt when several permission requests stack up
Improved fetch, skill, file read, sandbox network, Claude in Chrome, workflow script and notebook edit permission prompts to match the look of file edit prompts
Improved Bash, PowerShell and Monitor permission prompts to show the command between dashed lines, matching file edit prompts

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕清單支援滑鼠點選，排版對齊且捲軸增設箭頭
title.en: Fullscreen lists support mouse clicks with aligned layouts and scrollbar arrows

body.zh-TW: 在全螢幕下瀏覽落落長的項目時，清單操作與閱讀變得更加直覺。⟦好比翻閱排版整齊的商品目錄，頁面邊緣附有快速翻頁按鈕，點擊省略項目就能立刻跳轉至該區段。⟧「↑ N more」與「↓ N more」等折疊列現在支援滑鼠懸停、按下狀態與點擊直達列表端點。點擊「Thought for 4s」等收合列的文字間隙時，會正常展開內容而非僅反白。`/artifacts`、`/mcp`、`/skills` 與 `/hooks`（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）等清單中的詳細資訊皆統一對齊於同一欄位；沒有詳細資訊的列，例如名稱很長的操作列，不再把其他列的詳細資訊推向右側。捲軸新增可點擊或按住持續捲動的上下箭頭；在大多數清單中，省略列出現或消失時，捲軸不再跟著位移。
body.en: Browsing lengthy items in fullscreen mode is now more intuitive to navigate and read. ⟦Think of flipping through a neatly formatted catalog with quick-turn buttons on the page margins, where clicking an omitted item immediately jumps to that section.⟧ Collapsed rows like "↑ N more" and "↓ N more" now support mouse hover, pressed states, and clicks that navigate directly to the list ends. Clicking the text gaps of collapsed rows like "Thought for 4s" now properly expands content instead of merely highlighting text. Detailed information across lists such as `/artifacts`, `/mcp`, `/skills`, and `/hooks` is aligned in a single column. Rows without details, such as operation rows with long names, no longer push the details of other rows to the right. Scrollbars gain up and down arrows that can be clicked or held for continuous scrolling. In most lists, the scrollbar no longer shifts when ellipsis rows appear or disappear.

items.original:
Added mouse support for the "N more" rows of lists in fullscreen mode: click one to jump to that end of the list, with hover and pressed states
Fixed a click on the space between words of a collapsed row (such as "Thought for 4s") highlighting the row without expanding it in fullscreen mode
Fixed a row with no details, such as an action row with a long name, pushing every other row's details to the right in list screens
Improved list scrollbars in fullscreen mode: in most lists the bar no longer shifts as the "N more" rows come and go, and it now has ↑/↓ arrows you can click or hold to scroll
Changed list screens (`/artifacts`, `/mcp`, `/skills`, `/hooks` and others) to always line up each row's details in one column after the names
Changed the overflow rows of lists to read "↑ N more" / "↓ N more" instead of "N more above" / "N more below"

title.zh-TW: 憑證過期不再重複跳轉瀏覽器，精確標示登入狀態
title.en: Expired credentials avoid duplicate browser launches and accurately reflect login status

body.zh-TW: 同時開啟多個視窗或編輯器擴充功能時，帳號登入與憑證狀態不再打架。⟦有如社區保全更新通行證，只要在主櫃檯完成登記，各出入口隨即同步放行，不再要求重複出示證件。⟧當 gcpAuthRefresh 或 awsAuthRefresh 憑證過期時，多個行程不會再各自彈出瀏覽器登入頁面。macOS 工作階段在另一個視窗以 `/login` 登入成功後，即使殘留舊版 `~/.claude/.credentials.json` 檔案，也不會誤判為未登入。`claude auth status` 針對主控台儲存的金鑰會如實回報為 `api_key`，VS Code 擴充功能也會正確識別為金鑰工作階段。`/status` 在同時存在 API 金鑰時，會將 Anthropic 設定檔明確標註為未使用。
body.en: When running multiple windows or editor extensions simultaneously, account logins and credential states no longer conflict. ⟦A residential guard updates access passes so that once you register at the main counter, every entrance grants entry in sync without asking for repeated identification.⟧ When gcpAuthRefresh or awsAuthRefresh credentials expire, multiple processes will no longer each open separate browser login pages. After a macOS session logs in successfully via `/login` in another window, it is no longer misidentified as logged out even if a legacy `~/.claude/.credentials.json` file remains. `claude auth status` accurately reports console-stored keys as `api_key`, and the VS Code extension correctly identifies them as key sessions. When an API key is present, `/status` explicitly marks Anthropic profiles as unused.

items.original:
Fixed several Claude Code processes and IDE extensions each opening a login browser when gcpAuthRefresh or awsAuthRefresh credentials expire
Fixed macOS sessions still showing "Not logged in" or "Login expired" after `/login` succeeds in another Claude Code window when a leftover `~/.claude/.credentials.json` exists
Fixed `claude auth status` reporting a Console sign-in's stored API key as `claude.ai`; it now reports `api_key`, and the VS Code extension treats that session as an API key session
Fixed `/status` listing an Anthropic profile beside an API key as if both were in effect; the profile is now marked as not in use

title.zh-TW: 工作階段恢復不再遺失對話，修復非文字回傳引發的錯誤
title.en: Session resumption preserves conversations and fixes errors from non-text returns

body.zh-TW: 遇到終端機當機或非預期中斷時，重新接關不再面臨對話進度遺失的窘境。⟦正如遊戲中途斷線後重新連線，先前的對話紀錄連同平行工具呼叫後的內容都能找回，檔名過長的附加道具也能順利載入。⟧使用 `claude --resume` 或 `--continue` 恢復先前崩潰的工作階段（session）時，不會再遺失平行工具呼叫後的對話紀錄。工具或掛鉤回傳物件、數字或布林值等非純文字內容時，不再引發 API 400 錯誤；恢復的工作階段也適用。歷史紀錄極為龐大的雲端工作階段，容器不會在載入對話紀錄時提前停止而無法喚醒。附加檔名超長的檔案到雲端工作階段時，也能正常送達。
body.en: When encountering terminal crashes or unexpected interruptions, resuming work no longer risks losing conversation progress. ⟦Imagine reconnecting after disconnecting mid-game, where past chat logs alongside content after parallel tool calls are fully restored, and attached items with extra-long filenames load smoothly.⟧ Resuming a previously crashed session with `claude --resume` or `--continue` will no longer lose conversation history following parallel tool calls. Non-text returns from tools or hooks—such as objects, numbers, or booleans—no longer trigger API 400 errors, which also applies to resumed sessions. For cloud sessions with massive histories, containers no longer terminate prematurely during transcript loading and fail to wake. Files with extremely long filenames attached to cloud sessions can now also be delivered properly.

items.original:
Fixed `claude --resume` and `--continue` sometimes losing every turn after a batch of parallel tool calls when the earlier session crashed or was killed
Fixed API 400 errors after a tool or hook returned an object, number or boolean instead of text, including in resumed sessions
Fixed cloud sessions with very large histories never waking up because the container was stopped while the transcript was still loading
Fixed files with very long names not reaching a cloud session when attached to it

title.zh-TW: 模型不可用時自動切換同級備援，重試次數改採單一上限
title.en: Model unavailability triggers same-tier fallback with a unified retry limit

body.zh-TW: 當 API 拒絕預設模型或模型別名對應的模型時，你不必每輪都手動換模型。⟦宛若主發電機跳電時切換至備用機組，儀表板會亮燈提示輸出功率變化，避免反覆重新發動造成電力耗盡。⟧Claude Code 只重試一次，改用同等級的前一版模型備援（fallback）。備援模型與 `--fallback-model` 重試若無法高速運行，會以標準速度執行，並只在互動式工作階段顯示一次通知。若備援使上下文視窗從 1M 縮減至 200K token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位），備援通知與自動壓縮反覆觸發時的錯誤訊息都會標明容量變化。失敗的 API 請求改以單次模型呼叫為單位計算重試上限，預設設定下最多發送 14 次請求。僅持續一輪的備援也不會重複發送 Git 提交註記提醒。
body.en: When an API rejects the default model or the model mapped by an alias, you no longer need to switch models manually every turn. ⟦A backup generator kicks in when the main power trips, while the dashboard lights up to show output changes and prevent repeated restarts from draining battery reserves.⟧ Claude Code retries only once, falling back to an earlier model of the same tier. If the fallback model and `--fallback-model` retries cannot run at high speed, they execute at standard speed and display a notification only once in interactive sessions. If a fallback reduces the context window from 1M to 200K tokens, both the fallback notification and error messages from repeated auto-compaction will state the capacity change. Failed API requests now calculate their retry limit per individual model call, sending at most 14 requests under default settings. Single-turn fallbacks will also not send duplicate Git commit note reminders.

items.original:
Fixed every turn failing when the Anthropic API refuses the model your default or a model alias resolves to: Claude Code now retries once on the previous model of the same tier
Fixed refusal and `--fallback-model` retries failing when the fallback model can't run fast; they now run at standard speed, with a one-time notice in interactive sessions
Fixed the commit attribution reminder being re-sent inside tool output when a model fallback lasts only one turn
Improved the model fallback notice and the autocompact-thrashing error to say when a fallback dropped the context window from 1M to 200K tokens
Changed how failed API requests are retried: one limit now covers a whole model call, so with the default retry settings a failing call sends at most 14 requests

title.zh-TW: 遠端操控配合組織政策自動斷線，排隊訊息於重啟後接續處理
title.en: Remote Control disconnects on organization policy and queued messages resume on restart

body.zh-TW: 透過遠端操控（Remote Control）跨裝置連線時，連線狀態與訊息傳遞更加可靠。⟦如同對講機在總台關閉頻道時自動切斷並發出嗶聲，離線前收到的留言則妥善保存在收件匣等待下次開機。⟧當組織政策停用遠端操控時，包含 `claude remote-control` 在內的工作階段會主動中斷連線並顯示通知。透過遠端連線傳送的附加檔案若未成功送達，Claude 會獲知，且檔案最後一次下載嘗試有時只剩 10 秒的問題已修好。在程式即將退出時抵達的訊息不會被誤標為已送達，而是保留在佇列中供下次啟動時回覆。
body.en: Connecting across devices via Remote Control is now more dependable for connection states and message delivery. ⟦Consider a walkie-talkie that beeps and cuts off when the base station closes the channel, while messages received before going offline remain saved in an inbox for the next startup.⟧ When an organization policy disables Remote Control, sessions including `claude remote-control` proactively disconnect and display a notification. Claude is informed if attached files sent over remote connections fail to deliver, and an issue where the final download attempt sometimes had only 10 seconds remaining is resolved. Messages arriving right as the program exits are no longer mislabeled as delivered, remaining in the queue to be answered on the next run.

items.original:
Fixed Remote Control sessions (including `claude remote-control`) staying connected after your organization's policy turns Remote Control off; they now disconnect with a notice
